      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.cursor\\plans\\upstream統合と独自機能維持戦略_1e08ec1b.plan.md",
        "range": {

          },

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "3. テスト実行: &#96;cargo test --features custom-features&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "4. 独自機能の動作確認",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "## 実装詳細",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Cargo.tomlの更新",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml&#96;: &#96;custom-features&#96;フラグを維持",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/cli/Cargo.toml&#96;: &#96;custom-features&#96;の有効化を維持",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. lib.rsの更新",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "- 独自機能モジュールを&#96;#[cfg(feature = \"custom-features\")]&#96;で保護",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "- upstream/mainの変更を取り込みつつ、独自機能のエクスポートを維持",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. main.rsの更新",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "- 独自機能コマンドを&#96;#[cfg(feature = \"custom-features\")]&#96;で保護",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "- upstream/mainのCLI変更を取り込みつつ、独自機能コマンドを維持",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. orchestration/ディレクトリの保護",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "- 全体を条件付きコンパイルで保護",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "- upstream/mainにorchestration/が存在しない場合、完全に保持",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "## リスクと対策",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "### リスク1: コンフリクトの大量発生",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "**対策**: 段階的なマージ、各機能ごとに独立してテスト",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "### リスク2: 独自機能の動作不良",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "**対策**: マージ後に各独自機能の統合テストを実行",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "### リスク3: API互換性の問題",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "**対策**: 型定義の整合性を確認、必要に応じてアダプター層を追加",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "## 成功基準",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "1. upstream/mainの最新機能・バグフィクス・セキュリティ修正が取り込まれている",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "2. すべての独自機能が&#96;custom-features&#96;フラグで保護されている",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "3. ビルドが成功し、型エラーがない",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "4. 独自機能が正常に動作している",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "5. 公式リポジトリとの整合性が維持されている",
            "lineNumber": 140
          }
        ]
      },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\prompt.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 22
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "You are a coding agent running in the Codex CLI, a terminal-based coding assistant. Codex CLI is an open source project led by OpenAI. You are expected to be precise, safe, and helpful.",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "Your capabilities:",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "- Receive user prompts and other context provided by the harness, such as files in the workspace.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- Communicate with the user by streaming thinking &amp; responses, and by making &amp; updating plans.",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- Emit function calls to run terminal commands and apply patches. Depending on how this specific run is configured, you can request that these function calls be escalated to the user for approval before running. More on this in the \"Sandbox and approvals\" section.",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Within this context, Codex refers to the open-source agentic coding interface (not the old Codex language model built by OpenAI).",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "# How you work",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "## Personality",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "Your default personality and tone is concise, direct, and friendly. You communicate efficiently, always keeping the user clearly informed about ongoing actions without unnecessary detail. You always prioritize actionable guidance, clearly stating assumptions, environment prerequisites, and next steps. Unless explicitly asked, you avoid excessively verbose explanations about your work.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "# AGENTS.md spec",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- Repos often contain AGENTS.md files. These files can appear anywhere within the repository.",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- These files are a way for humans to give you (the agent) instructions or tips for working within the container.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- Some examples might be: coding conventions, info about how code is organized, or instructions for how to run or test code.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- Instructions in AGENTS.md files:",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    - The scope of an AGENTS.md file is the entire directory tree rooted at the folder that contains it.",
            "lineNumber": 22
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.30557981133461
    },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          {
            "text": "//! plan mode implementation",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Provides read-only planning phase with approval gates, budget enforcement,",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! and multiple execution strategies (single, orchestrated, competition).",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Integration with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module extends the official Plan Mode collaboration template",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! (&#96;codex-rs/core/templates/collaboration_mode/plan.md&#96;) with advanced features",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! while maintaining alignment with the official 2-phase conversational approach.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Structure",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode (improved in commits #9877, #9874) uses a conversational",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2-phase approach:",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 1. **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Understand what the user actually wants",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Key preferences/tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Bias toward questions over guessing",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2. **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Technical spec and implementation plan",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Rollout/monitoring, migrations/compat constraints",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Key Principles from Official Improvements",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Ask a lot, but never ask trivia**: Questions must materially change the spec/plan,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   confirm/lock assumptions, or choose between meaningful tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Batch questions**: 4-10 questions per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call to keep momentum",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Two kinds of unknowns**:",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   1. Discoverable facts: Explore first (≥2 targeted searches) before asking",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   2. Preferences/tradeoffs: Ask early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Finalization rule**: Only output final plan when remaining unknowns are low-impact",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   and explicitly listed as assumptions",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Custom Plan Features",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This module adds advanced capabilities beyond the official template:",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Budget management**: Token and time budgets with per-step and session caps",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Execution logging**: Detailed event-based logs of plan execution",
            "lineNumber": 43
          }
        ]
      },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\templates\\collaboration_mode\\plan.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 31
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Plan Mode (Conversational)",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "You work in 2 phases and you should *chat your way* to a great plan before finalizing it.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "PHASE 1 — Intent chat (what they actually want)",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- Keep asking until you can clearly state: goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state, and the key preferences/tradeoffs.",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- Bias toward questions over guessing: if any high‑impact ambiguity remains, do NOT plan yet—ask.",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- Include a “Confirm my understanding” question in each round (so the user can correct you early).",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "PHASE 2 — Implementation chat (what/how we’ll build)",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- Once intent is stable, keep asking until the spec is decision‑complete: approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow, edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria, rollout/monitoring, and any migrations/compat constraints.",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "## Hard interaction rule (critical)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "Every assistant turn MUST be exactly one of:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "A) a &#96;request_user_input&#96; tool call (questions/options only), OR",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "B) the final output: a titled, plan‑only document.",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "Rules:",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- No questions in free text (only via &#96;request_user_input&#96;).",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- Never mix a &#96;request_user_input&#96; call with plan content.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- Internal tool/repo exploration is allowed privately before A or B.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "## Ask a lot, but never ask trivia",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "You SHOULD ask many questions, but each question must:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- materially change the spec/plan, OR",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- confirm/lock an assumption, OR",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- choose between meaningful tradeoffs.",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "Batch questions (e.g., 4–10) per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call to keep momentum.",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "## Two kinds of unknowns (treat differently)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "1) Discoverable facts (repo/system truth): explore first.",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Before asking, run ≥2 targeted searches (exact + variant) and check likely sources of truth (configs/manifests/entrypoints/schemas/types/constants).",
            "lineNumber": 31
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.28412818908691406
    },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! The bottom pane is the interactive footer of the chat UI.",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The pane owns the [&#96;ChatComposer&#96;] (editable prompt input) and a stack of transient",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! [&#96;BottomPaneView&#96;]s (popups/modals) that temporarily replace the composer for focused",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//! interactions like selection lists.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Input routing is layered: &#96;BottomPane&#96; decides which local surface receives a key (view vs",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! composer), while higher-level intent such as \"interrupt\" or \"quit\" is decided by the parent",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! widget (&#96;ChatWidget&#96;). This split matters for Ctrl+C/Ctrl+D: the bottom pane gives the active",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! view the first chance to consume Ctrl+C (typically to dismiss itself), and &#96;ChatWidget&#96; may",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//! treat an unhandled Ctrl+C as an interrupt or as the first press of a double-press quit",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! shortcut.",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Some UI is time-based rather than input-based, such as the transient \"press again to quit\"",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! hint. The pane schedules redraws so those hints can expire even when the UI is otherwise idle.",

          },

## 確認結果

### 計画の妥当性

   - `orchestration/` ✓

1. ビルド検証
2. テスト実行

4. フォーマットチェック
5. 独自機能の動作確認

            "lineNumber": 4

            "lineNumber": 5
          },

            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## 概要",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "マルウェア検知エンジンと隔離システムを実装しました。リアルタイムファイルスキャン、シグネチャベース検知、ヒューリスティック検知、行動分析、および安全な隔離・削除・復元機能を提供します。",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "## 実装内容",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "### Phase 5.1: マルウェア検知機能",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1. &#96;malware_detector.rs&#96;の拡張",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },

            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "**実装内容**:",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- 既存の&#96;MalwareDetector&#96;に&#96;Quarantine&#96;統合を追加",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;auto_quarantine&#96;フラグによる自動隔離機能",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;with_quarantine()&#96;コンストラクタで隔離機能付き検知器を作成可能",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;set_quarantine()&#96;メソッドで後から隔離機能を設定可能",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- 検知時に自動隔離を実行する機能",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "**主な変更点**:",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    // ... existing fields ...",

          },
          {

          },

          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "**検知機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "- **シグネチャベース検知**: 既知のマルウェアパターンとの照合",
            "lineNumber": 47

          {

            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 53

            "text": "# 並列実行 &amp; カスタムエージェント クイックガイド",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 並列エージェント実行",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "### 基本コマンド",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel &lt;agent1&gt;,&lt;agent2&gt;,&lt;agent3&gt; \\",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "  --goals \"Goal 1,Goal 2,Goal 3\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "  --scopes ./path1,./path2,./path3 \\",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budgets 40000,30000,20000 \\",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  --deadline 15",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "### 実践例",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 例1: フルスタックレビュー",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,code-reviewer,test-gen \\",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "  --goals \"Review frontend,Review backend,Generate tests\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "  --scopes ./frontend,./backend,./tests \\",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budgets 50000,50000,40000",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "**実行時間**: 単一実行 18分 → 並列実行 6分（**66%短縮**）",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 例2: マルチ言語プロジェクト",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel ts-reviewer,python-reviewer,unity-reviewer \\",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  --goals \"TypeScript review,Python review,Unity review\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "  --scopes ./web,./api,./Assets \\",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budgets 40000,35000,30000 \\",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  --deadline 20 \\",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "  --out review-report.md",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 例3: セキュリティ多層スキャン",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel sec-audit,sec-audit,sec-audit \\",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "  --goals \"SQL injection,XSS scan,Dependency audit\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "  --scopes ./api,./web,./package.json \\",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budgets 30000,30000,20000",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "### オプション説明",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "| オプション | 説明 | 例 |",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "|-----------|------|---|",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--goals&#96; | 各エージェントのゴール（カンマ区切り） | &#96;\"Goal 1,Goal 2\"&#96; |",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🤖 カスタムエージェント作成",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "### 基本コマンド",

          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },

          {
            "text": "# OpenAI/codex との差異まとめ",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**作成日**: 2025年10月12日  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**対象ブランチ**: &#96;feat/openai-pr-preparation&#96;  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**ターゲット**: &#96;openai/codex:main&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "zapabob/codex は OpenAI/codex の公式フォークであり、以下の **本番環境対応の独自機能** を追加しています。",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "## ⚡ 主要な差異（zapabob/codex 独自機能）",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. **並列エージェント実行** (&#96;delegate-parallel&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "**OpenAI/codex**: ❌ なし（シングルスレッド非同期のみ）  ",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "**zapabob/codex**: ✅ &#96;tokio::spawn&#96; による真のマルチスレッド並列実行",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "# 複数エージェントを並列実行",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-gen \\",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  --goals \"セキュリティレビュー,テスト生成\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budgets \"5000,3000\"",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "**効果**: 逐次実行と比較して **2.5倍高速**",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. **動的エージェント生成** (&#96;agent-create&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "**OpenAI/codex**: ❌ なし（静的YAMLのみ）  ",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "**zapabob/codex**: ✅ LLM経由で実行時にエージェント生成",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "# 自然言語プロンプトからエージェント生成",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "codex agent-create \"セキュリティ脆弱性をスキャンするエージェントを作成\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budget 10000 \\",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "  --save",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "**効果**: YAML設定不要、**無限の柔軟性**",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. **メタオーケストレーション**",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "**OpenAI/codex**: ❌ なし（自己参照なし）  ",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "**zapabob/codex**: ✅ MCP経由でCodexが自分自身をサブエージェントとして使用",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "**効果**: **再帰的AIシステム**による無限の拡張性",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. **トークン予算管理** (&#96;TokenBudgeter&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "**OpenAI/codex**: ❌ なし  ",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "**zapabob/codex**: ✅ エージェント毎のトークン追跡と制限",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "**効果**: **コスト管理**と公平なリソース配分",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5. **包括的監査ログ** (&#96;AgentExecutionEvent&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "**OpenAI/codex**: ❌ 基本ログのみ  ",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "**zapabob/codex**: ✅ 構造化された実行イベントログ",
            "lineNumber": 70
          }
        ]
      },

Git差分分析\n   - 最近の変更の特定\n   - 非推奨APIの使用箇所の特定\n   - セキュリティ問題の特定\n\n2. コードレビュー\n   - 既存コードの品質評価\n   - 改善点の特定\n\n3. 最新APIへの再実装\n   - 非推奨APIの置き換え\n   - 最新のベストプラクティスの適用\n   - パフォーマンス最適化\n\n**実行コマンド**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ngit diff upstream/main...HEAD --name-only\ngit log --oneline --since=\"2025-01-01\" --until=\"2026-01-26\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 実装手順（優先順位順）\n\n### Phase 5.1: 基本ビルド・テスト検証（既存計画）\n1. ビルド検証\n2. テスト実行\n3. リンター実行\n4. フォーマットチェック\n5. 独自機能の動作確認\n\n### Phase 5.2: 型安全性と警告0達成\n1. Rust側の警告修正\n2. TypeScript側の型エラー修正\n3. ゼロトラストセキュリティ実装\n\n### Phase 5.3: React最新版更新\n1. 依存関係の更新\n2. 破壊的変更への対応\n3. 脆弱性スキャンと修正\n\n### Phase 5.4: VR/AR機能強化\n1. 追加デバイス対応\n2. デバイス固有の最適化\n\n### Phase 5.5: その他機能強化\n1. macOSライクサンドボックス\n2. DeepResearchレポート強化\n3. Windows 11 25H2 MCP対応\n4. マルウェア対策強化\n5. 複数AIツール並列実行GUI\n\n### Phase 5.6: コードレビューと再実装\n1. Git差分分析\n2. コードレビュー\n3. 最新APIへの再実装\n\n### Phase 5.7: 実装ログ作成\n1. すべての変更の記録\n2. &#96;_docs/&#96;への保存\n\n## 保護対象の確認\n\n以下のモジュールが&#96;#[cfg(feature = \"custom-features\")]&#96;で保護されていることを確認：\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/plan/&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/qc/&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/cowork_integration.rs&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/vr_ar_integration.rs&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/git4d_accelerated.rs&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/superior_git4d_visualizer.rs&#96;\n\n## リスクと対策\n\n1. **React 19アップグレード**\n   - リスク: 破壊的変更による動作不良\n   - 対策: 段階的なアップグレード、十分なテスト\n\n2. **型定義と警告0**\n   - リスク: 大規模なコード変更が必要\n   - 対策: 段階的な修正、既存機能の回帰テスト\n\n3. **ゼロトラスト実装**\n   - リスク: パフォーマンスへの影響\n   - 対策: パフォーマンステスト、段階的な実装\n\n## 完了基準\n\n- [ ] ビルドが成功する（エラー0件、警告0件）\n- [ ] テストが全て通過する\n- [ ] リンターエラーがない（警告0件）\n- [ ] フォーマットチェックが通過する\n- [ ] TypeScript型エラーがない\n- [ ] React 19.2.1+に更新済み\n- [ ] ゼロトラストセキュリティ実装済み\n- [ ] VR/AR機能が追加デバイスで動作する\n- [ ] macOSライクサンドボックスが動作する\n- [ ] DeepResearchレポートが正常に生成される\n- [ ] Windows 11 25H2 MCPが動作する\n- [ ] マルウェア検知が正常に動作する\n- [ ] 複数AIツール並列実行GUIが動作する\n- [ ] コードレビューと再実装が完了している\n- [ ] 実装ログを作成済み",
